about_the_game:
Your mouse is your LIFE – swing it without shame!

Welcome to Forward, a 3D side-scrolling hell where "physics engine" becomes "physics torture"! Ditch the keyboard; your mouse is the only savior (or killer). DRAG and WHIP that floppy (or rigid?) hero body with the cursor through brutal 3D stages – squirm, climb, launch, wrestle! One tiny mistake may send you spiraling to heaven, free-falling, or stuck in absurd corners questioning life. Excruciatingly brutal with bizarre deaths, yet your clumsy struggles might trigger explosive laughter or philosophical silence... Reach the end BY ANY MEANS! ROLL, MOUSE HERO! The ecstasy of victory will redeem all "agony".
